title: The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind® Game of the Year Edition

quotes.text: What a grand and intoxicating innocence! How could you be so naïve?
quotes.attrib: Dagoth Ur, at his own fortress

quotes.text: They have taken you from the Imperial City's prison, first by carriage, and now by boat.
I had it last week before their weekly 'Let's shake down Fargoth' ritual.
The Xbox port would secretly reboot itself mid-load to free up RAM, Todd Howard later revealed.
Oblivion later canonized Jiub as a saint for personally driving Morrowind's cliff racers into extinction.
Every player eventually stacks Fortify Intelligence potions into game-breaking alchemy loops.
New players fight the first screeching cliff racer. Everyone else just starts running.

notes: appid 22320 confirmed via Steam appdetails (type=game). Morrowind exists on Steam only as the Game of the Year Edition, which bundles the Tribunal and Bloodmoon expansions with no separate base-game-only SKU available, so this is the correct and only match for the Nexus 'Morrowind' domain. Character quotes verified verbatim against Wikiquote's Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind page (Dagoth Ur, Azura, Jiub) and UESP's Fargoth NPC dialogue page. The Xbox self-reboot trivia comes from Todd Howard's own account, widely reported (GameSpot, Hackaday) and corroborated by an .ini flag found in the game files calling XLaunchNewImage. The Saint Jiub/cliff-racer trivia is a confirmed Oblivion in-joke (St. Jiub's Fair in Cheydinhal, NPC dialogue) rather than a direct dev quote, so it's framed as trivia, not attributed as a real person's words.
